g.text: EOF questionnaire - Page 2/3 : generate and send, outside the pipeline
WARNING. NOTHING ON THIS PAGE IS AUTOMATIC.
No audit step calls this script: it is a
command to type, after reading the page 1/3 report.
ONE SINGLE file. The split into two, product and
technical, was removed: it routed nothing.
3 recipients out of 4 received questions in
Each question says in its title who to ask:
the product manager, the development team,
the person operating the infrastructure, the one
managing the data. It is an indication, not a
filing plan: roles depend too much on each client.
The order follows the yield: a client who stops
halfway has covered the maximum number of criteria
for the effort provided. The yield is calculated over
the REMAINING criteria, so a block whose measurement
already settled part of it drops back on its own.
markers in HTML comments so that the read-back does
An "I don't know" box is always offered, and
WAITING. The delay is asynchronous and not tooling-backed.
Nothing in the code sets a deadline, reminds
the contact, or tracks who answered what.
The transport is free: email, shared drive,
The file must come back under its original name, in the
audit directory: that is where the read-back looks for it.
If it does not come back, the read-back says so: it sets a
read_error state that the probe health check
catches. A questionnaire never returned therefore no
longer looks like an empty returned questionnaire.
